The '''L1-L War Machine''' was a type of small [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The L1-L War Machine was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with patch 5.2.0. and is available from the Warbound Crusader Pack.
